description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the BLEU score and the average lagging (AL) in simultaneous machine translation, comparing different consistency conditions. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," is linear and ranges from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick labels at every 2.5 units. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," is also linear, ranging from 25 to 33, with tick labels at every 1 unit. The plot includes four lines representing different conditions: "Consistency-CE" (purple dashed line with circle markers), "Inconsistency-CE" (blue dashed line with square markers), "Inconsistency-CE-MP" (red dashed line with star markers), and a grey line representing a reference or control condition. The "Consistency-CE" line starts at approximately 27 BLEU at 2.5 AL and ends at about 31 BLEU at 10 AL, showing a steady increase. The "Inconsistency-CE" line begins at around 26 BLEU and ends near 32 BLEU, also increasing steadily. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line starts at approximately 27 BLEU and ends at about 33 BLEU, with a similar steady increase. The grey line starts at around 29 BLEU and ends at about 32 BLEU, indicating a reference or control condition with a steady increase.
